definitions.pairFactor: product over i:Fin n and l in Finset.Ioi i of (Polynomial.X^(n^i.val) - Polynomial.X^(n^l.val))
definitions.Hhat: 1 + Polynomial.X^(2 * centralDegree n) + (CollisionDeterminantBridge.forwardMatrix b (CollisionDeterminantBridge.baseLabels n)).det * pairFactor n
definitions.amplitude: amplitude A i j = 1 + (A i j)^2 : Rat
definitions.markedWeights: b_ij = Polynomial.C (amplitude A i j) * Polynomial.X^(address i j) : Polynomial Rat
definitions.markedPermanent: sum over permutations sigma of Polynomial.C (product_i amplitude A i (sigma i)) * Polynomial.X^(sum_i address i (sigma i))

fixed_development_obligations.hhat_central_coefficient: forall n hn b, (Hhat n b).coeff (centralDegree n) = sum_sigma CollisionDeterminantBridge.weight b sigma
fixed_development_obligations.marked_A_central_identity: forall n hn A:Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Rat, (markedHhat A).coeff (centralDegree n) = markedPermanent A

required_supporting_obligations: Prove that the coefficients at K of 1 and X^(2*K) vanish when K>0
Import the exact frozen complementary-determinant/Vandermonde dependency only after its commit/hash is supplied
Rewrite the products of the marked rational weights to their amplitudes and addresses
